source.title: Lee Joon Gi And Sakaguchi Kentaro Are Drawn Into A New Stage Of The Deadly Game In “kiDnap GAME”

items.headline: Lee Joon Gi and Sakaguchi Kentaro Face New Clues in ‘kiDnap GAME’
items.dek: New stills preview another threat for detective Niide Toshiro as the thriller reveals a possible link to doctor Han Ki Joo.
body: Channel A’s “kiDnap GAME” has released new stills ahead of episode 6, as its survival game takes another turn for characters played by Lee Joon Gi and Sakaguchi Kentaro.

The thriller follows seven people caught in a kidnapping case spanning Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, Singapore, Bangkok, Naha and Manila. Each participant must complete a different mission ahead of the others to survive and save a loved one.

In the previous episode, objects found near eliminated participants added another layer to the mystery. A one-peso coin was placed in the hand of the granddaughter of Manila participant Miguel Garcia, played by Joel Torre, after he failed to prepare 10 million pesos in cash.

Bangkok participant Am Thanawan, played by Narupornkamol Chaisang, failed to expose a drug cartel; bread soaked in wine was used to gag her lover. Lipstick was also found on the lips of the deceased husband of Taipei participant Christina Lin, played by Alice Ko, after she failed to release a private video.

The objects connect to images in the show’s opening sequence: gold coins, a wine glass and a red apple. The ending scenes have shown the coins, glass or apple being destroyed or decaying when a participant is eliminated. Red rose petals have also been left alongside the clues.

The series is beginning to reveal how some participants may be connected. Seoul doctor Han Ki Joo, played by Lee Joon Gi, remembers an incident in Tokyo five years earlier after seeing Christina’s son. Han had been working at a Tokyo hospital at the time and treated a child with burn injuries.
Tokyo detective Niide Toshiro, played by Sakaguchi Kentaro, also reacts to the reference to Tokyo five years ago, suggesting a connection between the two men.

A young man played by Sho Kasamatsu adds to the uncertainty. After ambushing Niide’s junior detective, he appears at a Tokyo broadcasting station and offers reporter Isobe Akina, played by Sae Okazaki, an exclusive story.
Meanwhile, Niide is in Taipei when the perpetrator sends him a message saying a new stage has been prepared for him. Episode 6 airs November 10 at 10 p.m. KST.
items.socialCaption: New clues and a threat await in ‘kiDnap GAME.’ Read on HallyuScope for what the latest stills reveal ahead of episode 6.
items.seoDescription: New ‘kiDnap GAME’ stills preview a threat for Sakaguchi Kentaro’s detective and clues about his possible connection to Lee Joon Gi’s doctor.

source.title: Joy And Kim Hyun Jin’s Repeated Chance Encounters Lead To A Misunderstanding In “One-Of-A-Kind Romance”

items.headline: Joy and Kim Hyun Jin Get Off on the Wrong Foot in ‘One-of-a-Kind Romance’
items.dek: A string of chance meetings leaves a job seeker under a top star’s suspicion in the drama’s first two episodes.
body: Red Velvet’s Joy and Kim Hyun Jin are set for an uneasy first encounter in “One-of-a-Kind Romance,” whose first two episodes will be released on November 9 at 6 p.m. KST.

Based on a webtoon, the drama stars Joy as Gong Yu Il, a college graduate struggling to find work. She takes on jobs to make ends meet, including a night shift at a convenience store on the day of an interview.

It is at the store that she first meets Tak Mu I, a top star played by Kim Hyun Jin. When they cross paths again at a filming location, Tak Mu I, who is already dealing with a stalker, becomes suspicious of her.
For Gong Yu Il, the meetings are coincidences. For Tak Mu I, they raise questions, setting up a misunderstanding between the pair.

The drama follows their developing romance after Gong Yu Il unexpectedly becomes Tak Mu I’s manager. He is carrying emotional scars from a stalking incident and previously found strength in a novel she wrote years earlier.

Still images from the opening episodes also show Tak Mu I exchanging a glance with his manager, Kim Young Soo, played by Choi Kwon, after spotting Gong Yu Il. Na Hyun Young plays Gong Yu Il’s friend Yoo Yeon Joo, a drama production PD.
items.socialCaption: Joy and Kim Hyun Jin’s characters keep crossing paths—and not everyone thinks it’s a coincidence. Read on HallyuScope for a look at the drama’s opening episodes.
items.seoDescription: Joy and Kim Hyun Jin play a job seeker and a suspicious top star in ‘One-of-a-Kind Romance,’ premiering with two episodes on November 9.

body: “The Remarried Empress” has released new palace stills featuring its four leads, offering a look at the fantasy romance’s royal setting and costumes.

Based on the web novel of the same name, the series follows Navier, played by Shin Min Ah, the empress of the Eastern Empire. After her husband Sovieshu (Ju Ji Hoon) cheats on her with runaway slave Rashta (Lee Se Young) and divorces her, Navier marries Heinrey (Lee Jong Suk), a prince of the Western Empire.

The images, unveiled on November 9, include Navier and Sovieshu together in a garden, as well as a scene of Sovieshu on horseback. Other stills show Heinrey against a scenic backdrop and Rashta in colorful dresses.
The series released four episodes on November 3 and will continue with two new episodes every Wednesday.

source.title: Watch: Nam Ji Hyun And Kim Jae Yeong Bid Farewell To “Make Me Tingle” On Heartwarming Set Of Final Filming

items.headline: Nam Ji Hyun and Kim Jae Yeong Say Goodbye to ‘Make Me Tingle’ in Final Filming Video
items.dek: A new behind-the-scenes video follows the stars through romantic rehearsals and their closing remarks as filming wraps.
body: “Make Me Tingle” has released a behind-the-scenes video from episodes 9 and 10, giving fans a look at Nam Ji Hyun and Kim Jae Yeong’s final days on set.

The video shows the actors rehearsing a couple ring scene, where the cold weather becomes part of their playful exchange. After Nam suggests linking arms, Kim puts his hands in his pockets to keep warm, prompting her to suggest holding hands instead.
The pair also take photo booth pictures and cook together. Kim later shows the making-of camera his couple rings.
In their closing remarks, Kim playfully pretends to cry before reflecting on his second project with Nam. He says he is fond of the experience and happy with how filming ended.

Nam says she is relieved everyone finished filming without getting sick. She also credits Kim with making the set fun and giving her plenty of reasons to laugh. “Make Me Tingle” has recently concluded.
items.socialCaption: Nam Ji Hyun and Kim Jae Yeong share their final moments on the “Make Me Tingle” set. Read HallyuScope for highlights from the behind-the-scenes video.

source.title: 6 Workplace C-Dramas Where Women Took Charge

items.headline: 6 Chinese Workplace Dramas About Women Finding Their Own Paths
items.dek: From consulting to law and entrepreneurship, these dramas follow women balancing career ambitions with personal challenges.
body: Workplace dramas can put more than office rivalries in the spotlight. These six Chinese series follow women making decisions about their careers, relationships and futures, whether they are navigating a demanding employer or starting a business of their own.

The Rational Life
Qin Lan plays Shen Ruo Xin, a senior manager in an automobile company’s legal department who faces gender discrimination at work and pressure to marry at home. When optimistic intern Qi Xiao (Dylan Wang) enters her life, his support prompts her to reconsider her views on relationships while she continues to make choices for herself.

Nothing But Thirty
Set in Shanghai, this drama follows three women as they enter their thirties. Luxury saleswoman Wang Man Ni (Maggie Jiang) hopes to build a better life, Gu Jia (Tong Yao) balances family responsibilities with helping run her husband’s fireworks business, and Zhong Xiao Qin (Mao Xiao Tong) reassesses her choices amid marital difficulties. Their intersecting stories explore ambition, financial independence and friendship.

Irreplaceable
Zhao Jin Mai stars as Xu Chi, a newcomer determined to prove herself in the competitive consulting industry. Elite consultant Ye Xin Zhi (Wei Da Xun), who is dealing with the fallout of a former superior’s betrayal, becomes her mentor. Their relationship develops alongside workplace rivalries and career challenges.

As Beautiful As You
After growing frustrated with her job, technology professional Ji Xing (Tan Song Yun) leaves to launch a medical technology start-up. Building the company brings setbacks, but she eventually gains the backing of investor Han Ting (Xu Kai). Their partnership turns romantic, even as Ji Xing remains intent on pursuing her goals on her own terms.

Love Has Fireworks
Investment banker Qian Fei (Wang Chu Ran) must rethink her future after her fiancé leaves her and she is left with a mortgage. She rents a room to Li Yi Fei (Tan Jian Ci), another investment banking professional, to ease the financial strain. The pair initially clash, but grow closer as they share a home and work on projects together.

She and Her Perfect Husband
Career-focused lawyer Qin Shi (Yang Mi) becomes a candidate for a position at a law firm that requires applicants to be married, unaware that her brother has falsely listed her as a wife. She later meets Yang Hua (Xu Kai), and the two agree to marry. Their arrangement brings professional and family pressures into focus as their relationship develops.
items.socialCaption: Looking for a C-drama with ambitious women at its center? Explore six workplace stories on HallyuScope.
items.seoDescription: Discover six Chinese workplace dramas following women in law, consulting, banking and business as they navigate careers and relationships.

body: Kim Woo Bin and Seo Eun Soo explore a baseball question in a new teaser for tvN’s upcoming drama “GIFT”: does natural talent or effort offer a better chance of winning?

Based on a webtoon, the sports drama stars Kim as Jung Min Yong, a former professional baseball pitching coach. After an unexpected accident gives him a special ability, he becomes head coach of the high school team ranked last in the nation.

In the teaser, Jung Min Yong presents innate talent and detailed statistics gained through effort as two routes to victory. Seo Eun Soo’s character, Yoon Seo Jin, asks which has the higher probability of winning.
“GIFT” premieres December 5 at 9:10 p.m. KST.

source.title: CORTIS, Stray Kids, NMIXX, SEVENTEEN’s JxJ, K/DA, ILLIT, ENHYPEN, BTS, And More Sweep Top Spots On Billboard World Albums Chart

items.headline: CORTIS Returns to No. 1 on Billboard World Albums Chart as NMIXX and JxJ Debut
items.dek: GREENGREEN leads the chart for a sixth week, while new releases from NMIXX, SEVENTEEN’s JxJ, K/DA and ILLIT enter the top 10.
body: CORTIS is back at No. 1 on Billboard’s World Albums chart for the week ending November 7. The group’s EP “GREENGREEN” returned to the top for its sixth week in the position and re-entered the Billboard 200 six months after its release.
CORTIS also charted with debut EP “COLOR OUTSIDE THE LINES,” which placed No. 22 in its 60th week on the World Albums chart.
Stray Kids held three spots, led by “THIS & THAT” at No. 2 in its 12th week. “KARMA” ranked No. 9 in its 59th week, while “DO IT” came in at No. 18 in its 41st.
Two new releases followed at Nos. 3 and 4: NMIXX’s EP “Strange Muse” and “DREAMSCAPE,” the debut mini album from SEVENTEEN unit JxJ, made up of Jeonghan and Joshua.

ENHYPEN’s “THE SIN : BLISS” placed No. 5 in its 10th week. League of Legends virtual group K/DA debuted at No. 6 with “FIRESTARTER,” while ILLIT’s “BREAK EVEN” entered at No. 7 ahead of its U.S. physical release. ILLIT’s earlier mini album “MAMIHLAPINATAPAI” ranked No. 13 in its 26th week.
BTS also had two albums on the chart: “Map of the Soul: 7 ~The Journey~” at No. 12 and “Love Yourself: Answer,” which re-entered at No. 15 for its 206th week.

Further down, ATEEZ’s “GOLDEN HOUR : Part.5” ranked No. 16, followed by NewJeans’ “Get Up” at No. 17 and BOYNEXTDOOR’s “HOME” at No. 19. LE SSERAFIM’s “PUREFLOW” placed No. 21, and EVAN (Heeseung)’s “DEATH OF ME” came in at No. 24.
items.socialCaption: CORTIS is back at No. 1, with NMIXX and JxJ among the chart’s new arrivals. Read HallyuScope for the full rundown.
items.seoDescription: CORTIS leads Billboard’s World Albums chart as NMIXX, SEVENTEEN’s JxJ, K/DA and ILLIT debut in the top 10. See where other albums ranked.

source.title: ILLIT Debuts At No. 1 On Billboard Top Album Sales Chart + No. 6 On Billboard 200 With “BREAK EVEN”

items.headline: ILLIT Earns First Billboard 200 Top 10 Entry With ‘BREAK EVEN’
items.dek: The mini album also opened at No. 1 on Billboard’s Top Album Sales chart, marking another first for the group.
body: ILLIT has landed its first top 10 entry on the Billboard 200 with “BREAK EVEN,” which debuted at No. 6 on the U.S. albums chart.
The mini album also entered Billboard’s Top Album Sales chart at No. 1, becoming the group’s first release to lead that ranking. Billboard announced the results on November 8 local time.

According to Luminate, “BREAK EVEN” earned 37,000 equivalent album units in the week ending November 5. That total included 32,500 traditional album sales—ILLIT’s biggest U.S. sales week to date—and 4,500 streaming equivalent album units, representing 4.87 million on-demand audio streams.
“BREAK EVEN” is ILLIT’s fifth Billboard 200 entry. Its predecessor on the chart, “MAMIHLAPINATAPAI,” peaked at No. 26.

items.seoDescription: ILLIT’s “BREAK EVEN” debuts at No. 6 on the Billboard 200 and No. 1 on Top Album Sales, giving the group two new chart milestones in the U.S.

body: xikers has reached a new first-week sales high with its mini album “ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING,” according to Hanteo Chart.

The release sold 370,935 copies from November 2 through November 8, Soompi reported. That total exceeds the KQ Entertainment boy group’s previous first-week record of 364,152 copies, set by its preceding mini album, “ROUTE ZERO : The ORA,” earlier this year.
“ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING” was released on November 2 alongside its title track, “DIENAMITE.” The new total puts the group’s first-week sales 6,783 copies above its previous record.

body: ILLIT has set a new personal first-week sales record with its fifth mini album, “BREAK EVEN.”

The album sold 444,072 copies during its first week of release, from October 26 to November 1, according to Hanteo Chart. That total puts it 32,418 copies ahead of the group’s previous first-week best.
The earlier record was held by ILLIT’s previous mini album, “MAMIHLAPINATAPAI,” which sold 411,654 copies in its first week. The group released that album earlier this year.
“BREAK EVEN” marks ILLIT’s latest comeback and features the title track “You’re Under Arrest.”

source.title: CORTIS’s “GREENGREEN” Re-Enters Billboard 200 6 Months After Its Release

items.headline: CORTIS’ ‘GREENGREEN’ Returns to Billboard 200 at No. 90
items.dek: The group’s second EP re-entered the U.S. albums chart six months after its release and returned to No. 1 on World Albums.
body: CORTIS’ second EP, “GREENGREEN,” is back on the Billboard 200 six months after its release.
The EP re-entered the chart at No. 90 for the week ending November 7, according to Soompi. It previously debuted at No. 3 in May.
The return marks the album’s 19th non-consecutive week on the Billboard 200, extending its record as CORTIS’ longest-charting album.
“GREENGREEN” also reclaimed the No. 1 spot on Billboard’s World Albums chart, where it has now spent six non-consecutive weeks at the top. On the Top Album Sales chart, it climbed to No. 5.
CORTIS rose to No. 59 on the Artist 100, marking the group’s 25th overall week on that chart.
